title: A first step into AI: a 10-minute interactive guide | halilneed
name: A first step into AI
desc: A 10-minute interactive guide for people at work: what AI is, how it learns, where to use it at work and where not to.
ogDesc: Four experiments in 10 minutes: what AI is, how it learns, where to use it at work and where not to.
heroP: Try it instead of reading about it. The basics of using AI in the right places at work.
printNote: This PDF is the printed version of an interactive guide. To run the experiments yourself:
s1p: Nobody writes the rule. It finds the pattern in examples.
nwTitle: How does ChatGPT write? Pick the next word yourself
note1: It writes what is likely, not what is true. Checking is your job.
s2p: Add examples and watch it change on six messages it has never seen.
privacy: The model runs on this page. Nothing you type is sent anywhere.
s3h: Where does it fit at work?
s3p: Ten tasks. Make your call on each one.
s4p: AI in the middle, you at both ends.
r1: The draft is the AI’s, the decision is yours
ctaP: A first AI pilot, choosing a model, personal data.
footer: No cookies. Visits are counted in aggregate with GoatCounter.
